newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo low grown teas weaken again on big volume.
newsitem.headline: Colombo low grown teas weaken again on big volume.

text.p: Prices of Sri Lanka's distinct low grown teas, the mainstay of the Colombo auction, fell again as large volumes were on offer, brokers said on Wednesday.
The anticipated gross sale average for the 6.2 million kg on offer fell to about 103.75 rupees per kg (from 104.25 rupees last week, broker Forbes and Walker said.

"The market fell because prices of low growns were low," said a Forbes and Walker broker. "There was a large volume of low growns on offer. Even next week is going to be a large sale. We have still not cleared the backlog (caused by December holidays)."
Among high grown teas, better Western BOP/BOPFs were mostly 3-5 rupees dearer, as were better Uva/Udapussellawa BOP/BOPFs.
The next auction is on February 25-26 with 6.3 million kg on offer. (1$=57.66 rupees)
